_description: Black swan overlay applied on top of historical_single mode. Confirms the overlay REPLACES drawn factors regardless of which base generator is active — so a 1966 slice with a black swan in 2028 still gets the prescribed multipliers in 2028, not the recorded 1968 returns. Tests the same overlay invariant as black-swan-overlay.json but with a historical base instead of parametric.
_rationale: 1966-1970 slice with a single black swan in year 2028 (yearIndex=2). Without the overlay, year 2 would use 1968 historical returns. With the overlay, year 2's blended factor = 0.6*0.5 + 0.4*0.9 = 0.66 (same as black-swan-overlay.json). This isolates the overlay's REPLACE-not-SCALE behavior under historical mode. Pure accumulation with $500k Roth, no spending, no income, zero parametric inflation — the displayed real-balance trajectory is the running product of slice factors with year 2 forced to 0.66. probability=100 because zero spending cannot deplete the balance.
name: Historical 1966 + Black Swan 2028
